title: “Non-Marginal” Investor Beliefs
title_primary: “Non-Marginal” Investor Beliefs
authors: William N. Goetzmann, Dasol Kim, Robert J. Shiller
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides evidence of how the beliefs of investors who step out of the market, or “non-marginal” investors, influence asset prices. Using more than two decades of respondent-level investor surveys, we construct wedge measures that quantify the distance between subjective investor beliefs and option-implied benchmarks. We use self-identified proxies for market participation to document that these wedges correspond with the beliefs of non-marginal investors. Non-marginal investors are generally more pessimistic in their market return forecasts and perceive greater crash risks than the pricing population. Subjective crash beliefs are a key determinant of participation, even when controlling for expected return beliefs. This heterogeneity, in part, explains the negative association between average expected returns estimated from surveys and future realized market returns. In the cross-section, stocks with greater sensitivity to non-marginal beliefs earn lower returns, particularly where disagreement is high. Taken together, the results provide evidence of a composition channel in which belief-driven exit concentrates risk among fewer investors.

title: Fiscal Policy and the Saving Glut of the Rich
title_primary: Fiscal Policy and the Saving Glut of the Rich
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Nicoló Ceneri, Leonardo Melosi, Alessandro Villa
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Since the 1980s, the United States has experienced a pronounced saving glut of the rich, a large accumulation of assets among the top 1% of earners. We argue that this development partly reflects a shift in the financing of redistributive policies, from inflationary finance in the 1960s and 1970s to debt finance backed by future taxation beginning in the early 1980s. The central insight is that, in the presence of a progressive tax system, a switch from inflationary to debt financing leads to debt accumulation by top earners. We develop a New Keynesian model with borrowers and savers in which redistributive transfers can be either funded or unfunded. Unfunded transfers generate fiscal inflation that erodes the real value of public and private debt, redistributing wealth through asset revaluation effects. Funded transfers, by contrast, are financed through future taxes borne primarily by high-income households, which respond by accumulating claims on both households and the government. Using a structurally estimated version of the model, we find that the shift from unfunded to funded redistribution in the 1980s contributed significantly to the subsequent saving glut of the rich.

title: DP20291 Decoupling Taste-Based versus Statistical Discrimination in Elections
title_zh: 选举中基于品味与统计性歧视的分离
title_primary: 选举中基于品味与统计性歧视的分离
title_secondary: DP20291 Decoupling Taste-Based versus Statistical Discrimination in Elections
authors: Amanda de Albuquerque, Frederico Finan, Anubhav Jha, Laura Karpuska, Francesco Trebbi
official: 官方在线 2025-05-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We present a methodology for decoupling taste-based versus statistical discrimination in political behavior. We combine a flexible empirical model of voting, featuring vertical and horizontal candidate differentiation in gender, ability, and policy positions, with a large-scale micro-targeted electoral experiment aimed at increasing female candidate vote shares. Our structural econometric approach allows to separately identify preference parameters driving taste-based discrimination and beliefs parameters driving statistical discrimination through expectations about ability and policy positions of female politicians. Our application to Brazilian municipal elections uncovers substantial levels of taste-based and statistical discrimination. Counterfactual political campaigns show promise in reducing both.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种方法论，用于在政治行为中区分基于偏好的歧视与统计性歧视。我们将一个灵活的投票经验模型——该模型包含候选人在性别、能力及政策立场上的纵向与横向差异化——与一项旨在提升女性候选人得票份额的大规模微观定向选举实验相结合。我们的结构计量方法能够分别识别驱动基于偏好歧视的偏好参数，以及通过关于女性政治家能力和政策立场的预期驱动统计性歧视的信念参数。将其应用于巴西市政选举中，我们揭示了显著的基于偏好和统计性歧视现象。反事实政治竞选活动显示出在减少这两种歧视方面具有潜力。

title: Multilevel Marketing: Pyramid-Shaped Schemes or Exploitative Scams?
title_zh: 多层次营销：金字塔式计划还是剥削性骗局？
title_primary: 多层次营销：金字塔式计划还是剥削性骗局？
title_secondary: Multilevel Marketing: Pyramid-Shaped Schemes or Exploitative Scams?
authors: Yair Antler
official: 官方在线 2018-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We identify the conditions on the tendency of agents to spread information by word of mouth, under which a principal can design a pyramid scam to exploit a network of boundedly rational agents whose beliefs are coarse. Our main result is that a pyramid scam is sustainable only if its underlying reward scheme compensates the participants based on multiple levels of their downlines (e.g., for recruiting new members to the pyramid and for recruitments made by these new members). Motivated by the growing discussion on the legitimacy of multilevel marketing schemes and their resemblance to pyramid scams, we use our model to compare the two phenomena based on their underlying compensation structure.
abstract_zh: 我们识别了代理人通过口口相传传播信息的倾向条件，在此条件下，委托人能够设计一个金字塔骗局，以利用信念粗糙的有限理性代理人网络。我们的主要结论是，金字塔骗局只有在奖励方案基于下线多个层级对参与者进行补偿时（例如，为招募新成员加入金字塔以及这些新成员进行的招募）才可持续。鉴于多层次营销计划合法性及其与金字塔骗局相似性的讨论日益增多，我们运用模型基于其补偿结构对这两种现象进行比较。

title: Looking for Underlying Structure in WEO Forecasts
title_zh: 探寻世界经济展望预测中的潜在结构
title_primary: 探寻世界经济展望预测中的潜在结构
title_secondary: Looking for Underlying Structure in WEO Forecasts
authors: Yurii Sholomytskyi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the statistical properties of the IMF’s World Economic Outlook (WEO) projections over 1999–2023 for 29 economies. The optimism of WEO growth forecasts is well established; we confirm it and look behind it at two features of how the forecasts are built. First, the growth of the systemic economies (the United States and China) appears to be underutilized in the projections: forecasts embed less of the cross-country growth comovement present in the data, a gap we term forecast fragmentation that did not narrow over the sample. Second, the conditional growth–inflation link present in the historical data is weakly represented in the projections. These patterns suggest that structural models, in which such cross-country and real–nominal linkages can be verified through estimation, could be a useful complement to expert judgment, serving as a baseline check for medium-term anchors.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了国际货币基金组织《世界经济展望》1999年至2023年间对29个经济体的预测统计特性。WEO增长预测的乐观倾向已广为人知；我们对此予以确认，并深入探究其背后预测构建的两个特征。首先，系统性经济体（美国和中国）的增长在预测中似乎未被充分利用：预测所蕴含的跨国增长联动性低于数据中实际存在的程度，这一差距我们称之为预测碎片化，且该差距在样本期内并未收窄。其次，历史数据中存在的条件性增长-通胀关联在预测中体现较弱。这些模式表明，结构模型——通过估计可验证此类跨国及实际-名义联系——或可作为专家判断的有益补充，充当中期锚定的基准检验。

title: The Coming Great Repression? New Measures and a Century of Evidence
title_zh: 即将到来的大萧条？新度量与百年证据
title_primary: 即将到来的大萧条？新度量与百年证据
title_secondary: The Coming Great Repression? New Measures and a Century of Evidence
authors: Marijn A. Bolhuis & Jakree Koosakul & Mr. Neil Shenai & Jie Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Governments have historically used financial repression to reduce debt and fiscal pressures, yet few systematic measures of repression exist. To fill this gap, we introduce two quantity-based repression indicators grounded in a structural portfolio-choice model, exploiting the gap in government-bond demand between captive and non-captive investors. A narrow fiscal indicator captures pressure on banks to hold government bonds. A consolidated measure adds the perimeter of central bank liabilities. Applying our measures to a novel dataset of 17 advanced economies since 1920, we find that financial repression has been a persistent feature of modern history, peaking after World War II, receding during the capital account liberalization era, and rising again after the Global Financial Crisis. Our measures correlate with conditions typically associated with repression—such as high debt burdens and restricted capital mobility—along with crowding out of private investment and credit. Using a debt decomposition framework, we show that repression was a major driver of debt reduction after World War II, generating larger fiscal savings than traditional seigniorage, and has again generated fiscal savings since the Global Financial Crisis. With the conditions historically associated with elevated repression present today, our evidence suggests that financial repression may see increased use going forward.
abstract_zh: 政府历来通过金融压抑来减轻债务和财政压力，然而，关于金融压抑的系统性衡量指标却寥寥无几。为填补这一空白，我们基于结构性资产组合选择模型，利用受约束与非受约束投资者之间政府债券需求的差距，提出了两个基于数量的压抑指标。一个狭窄的财政指标捕捉了银行持有政府债券的压力。一个综合指标则纳入了中央银行负债的范围。我们将这些指标应用于自1920年以来17个发达经济体的新数据集，发现金融压抑一直是现代历史中的一个持久特征，在二战后达到顶峰，在资本账户自由化时期有所消退，并在全球金融危机后再次上升。我们的指标与通常与压抑相关的条件——如高债务负担和资本流动受限——以及私人投资和信贷的挤出效应相关联。利用债务分解框架，我们表明压抑是二战后债务减少的主要驱动力，产生的财政节省超过了传统的铸币税，并且自全球金融危机以来再次产生了财政节省。鉴于当前存在历史上与压抑加剧相关的条件，我们的证据表明，金融压抑未来可能会得到更广泛的应用。

title: Integrating landscape multifunctionality into the identification of potential land use conflict zones in cultural landscapes
title_zh: 将景观多功能性纳入文化景观潜在土地利用冲突区域识别
title_primary: 将景观多功能性纳入文化景观潜在土地利用冲突区域识别
title_secondary: Integrating landscape multifunctionality into the identification of potential land use conflict zones in cultural landscapes
authors: Xuewei Zhang, Shiying Li, Tao He, Wei Ren, Fangzheng Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land use conflicts in cultural landscapes are difficult to detect under strict spatial regulation, yet they may substantially affect landscape sustainability. This study introduces a landscape multifunctionality framework to identify potential land use conflicts as spatial competition generated by the co-location and interaction of multiple landscape functions. The framework was applied to the Mulanbei Irrigation Area in Putian, China. Using historical land-cover maps, content analysis, seven representative functions across ecological, productive, social, and cultural dimensions were identified and mapped. We examined land use change, functional gains and losses, trade-offs and synergies, and landscape pattern to identify potential land use conflict zones and classify the levels of potential land use conflicts. The results indicate that land use change from 2014 to 2022 was limited overall, but spatially constrained. Construction land increased by 19.64 km² (+17.18%), mainly at the expense of cropland and water bodies, while cropland decreased by 14.67 km² and water bodies declined by 29.93%. Leisure and recreation increased by 101.41%, while food supply, habitat maintenance, and carbon sequestration decreased by 13.41%, 7.71%, and 5.76%. Potential conflict zones remained scattered, but ecological-cultural trade-offs were associated with broader spatial extent and higher conflict levels. The highest conflict level occurred in water bodies, followed by cropland and woodland, reflecting intensified riparian functional mixing, cropland trade-offs between grain production and multifunctional use, and the role of woodland in limiting ecological loss. These findings support periodic assessment, place-specific governance, and complementary functional networks for heritage conservation and adaptive development.
abstract_zh: 文化景观中的土地利用冲突在严格的空间规制下难以被察觉，然而它们可能对景观可持续性产生重大影响。本研究引入景观多功能性框架，将潜在的土地利用冲突识别为多种景观功能在空间上共存与相互作用所产生的空间竞争。该框架应用于中国莆田木兰陂灌区。利用历史土地覆盖图、内容分析等方法，识别并绘制了涵盖生态、生产、社会和文化维度的七项代表性功能。我们考察了土地利用变化、功能增益与损失、权衡与协同关系以及景观格局，以识别潜在的土地利用冲突区域，并对潜在冲突水平进行分级。结果表明，2014年至2022年间土地利用变化总体有限，但在空间上受到约束。建设用地增加了19.64平方公里（+17.18%），主要占用耕地和水体，而耕地减少了14.67平方公里，水体减少了29.93%。休闲娱乐功能增加了101.41%，而食物供给、栖息地维护和碳固存功能分别下降了13.41%、7.71%和5.76%。潜在冲突区域保持分散分布，但生态-文化权衡与更广泛的空间范围和更高的冲突水平相关联。最高冲突水平出现在水体，其次是耕地和林地，反映出河岸功能混合加剧、耕地在粮食生产与多功能利用之间的权衡，以及林地在限制生态损失方面的作用。这些发现为遗产保护与适应性发展的周期性评估、因地制宜的治理以及互补性功能网络构建提供了支持。

title: Beyond Social Death: A Review Essay of Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson
title_zh: 超越社会性死亡：奥兰多·帕特森《奴役：过去与现在》书评
title_primary: 超越社会性死亡：奥兰多·帕特森《奴役：过去与现在》书评
title_secondary: Beyond Social Death: A Review Essay of Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson
authors: Wantchekon, Leonard
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Enslavement: Past and Present by Orlando Patterson should be required reading for any economist or economic historian interested in long-run development and growth, race, inequality, political economy, or institutional development. Patterson synthesizes decades of his cross-disciplinary scholarship into an ambitious comparative framework to understand slavery, built on two main pillars: (i) slavery as “social death”, defined as a condition of total domination, natal alienation and dishonor, and (ii) a “bundle of rights” approach that permits systematic comparison across societies and periods. This review, after summarizing the book’s central arguments, offers three critiques—the limited applicability of social death to West and Central African slavery, insufficient attention to the Transatlantic Slave Trade, and the problematic extension to “modern slavery”—and proposes a research agenda focused on agency and resilience, diasporic identity, and reparations.
abstract_zh: 奥兰多·帕特森的《奴役：过去与现在》应成为任何关注长期发展与增长、种族、不平等、政治经济学或制度发展的经济学家或经济史学家的必读书目。帕特森将其数十年的跨学科学术研究整合为一个宏大的比较框架来理解奴隶制，该框架建立在两大支柱之上：（一）奴隶制作为“社会性死亡”，即一种完全支配、出生疏离与耻辱的状态；（二）一套“权利束”方法，允许跨社会与跨时期的系统性比较。本文在总结该书核心论点后提出三点批评——社会性死亡对西非与中非奴隶制的适用性有限、对大西洋奴隶贸易的关注不足，以及将其延伸至“现代奴隶制”的问题——并提出了一个聚焦于能动性与韧性、散居身份认同及赔偿问题的研究议程。

title: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives
title_zh: 具有扩散激励的内生网络形成
title_primary: 具有扩散激励的内生网络形成
title_secondary: Endogenous network formation with diffusion incentives
authors: Noémie Cabau
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper proposes a non-cooperative game of network formation in which creating access to the network – for oneself and others – is a public good. Link formation therefore reflects a trade-off between the social value of links and their private cost. The paper characterizes the architecture of strict Nash networks. Strict Nash equilibria are either flat or hierarchical. Flat equilibria consist of a wheel (i.e., a directed cycle) that may or may not encompass all agents. Hierarchical equilibria are trees in which some agents act as intermediaries between otherwise disconnected groups. When the cost of link formation is sufficiently low, the exhaustive wheel is the unique equilibrium architecture and best-response dynamics converge to it with probability one. For intermediate costs, multiple equilibrium architectures coexist and can be Pareto-ranked: the exhaustive wheels dominate the non-exhaustive ones and the empty network, and trees dominate the empty network.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种网络形成的非合作博弈模型，在该模型中，为自己及他人创建网络接入具有公共品属性。因此，链接形成反映了链接的社会价值与其私人成本之间的权衡。本文刻画了严格纳什网络的架构特征。严格纳什均衡要么是扁平结构，要么是层级结构。扁平均衡由轮状结构（即有向环）构成，该结构可能包含所有参与者，也可能不包含。层级均衡则呈现树状结构，其中部分参与者充当原本互不相连群体之间的中介。当链接形成成本足够低时，全覆盖轮状结构是唯一的均衡架构，且最优反应动态以概率1收敛于此结构。在中等成本条件下，多种均衡架构并存且可进行帕累托排序：全覆盖轮状结构优于非全覆盖轮状结构及空网络，而树状结构优于空网络。

title: DP1518 A Stochastic Dynamic General Equilibrium Model for Greece
title_zh: 希腊随机动态一般均衡模型
title_primary: 希腊随机动态一般均衡模型
title_secondary: DP1518 A Stochastic Dynamic General Equilibrium Model for Greece
authors: Tryphon Kollintzas, Vanghelis Vassilatos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In this paper we develop a stochastic dynamic general equilibrium model of the Greek economy, in the real business cycle modelling tradition. Household preferences depend on private and public consumption and leisure. Government finances its investment, consumption and transfer payments by means of a proportional income tax rate. Households buy and sell foreign assets in an international capital market and also receive transfer payments from abroad. The volatility, persistence, and co-movement properties of the business cycle component of the data generated by the model are broadly consistent with the actual behaviour of the corresponding actual data of the Greek economy, in 1960?92. We use the model to investigate the response of major macroeconomic variables to temporary and permanent changes in government policy variables, foreign transfers and the rate of return on foreign assets.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个基于实际经济周期建模传统的希腊经济随机动态一般均衡模型。家庭偏好取决于私人消费、公共消费及闲暇。政府通过比例所得税率为其投资、消费及转移支付提供资金。家庭在国际资本市场上买卖外国资产，并接收来自国外的转移支付。模型生成数据中经济周期成分的波动性、持续性及协同变动特征，与1960-1992年间希腊经济实际数据的对应表现基本一致。我们利用该模型考察了主要宏观经济变量对政府政策变量、国外转移支付及外国资产回报率的暂时性与永久性变化的响应。

title: The Causal Effect of BMI on Hypertension: A Copula Model Approach with Genetic Risk Instruments
title_zh: BMI对高血压的因果效应：基于遗传风险工具与Copula模型的方法
title_primary: BMI对高血压的因果效应：基于遗传风险工具与Copula模型的方法
title_secondary: The Causal Effect of BMI on Hypertension: A Copula Model Approach with Genetic Risk Instruments
authors: Dettoni, Robinson, Petri, BÃ¶ckerman,, Bahamondes, Cliff, Vasquez, Jose, Carlos, YÃ©venes, 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper estimates the causal effect of body mass index (BMI) on hypertension risk using data from the Young Finns Study. The empirical framework combines genetic instruments for BMI with a triangular copula model that accommodates a binary outcome and a continuous endogenous treatment, allowing unobserved determinants of BMI and hypertension to be correlated through alternative symmetric and asymmetric copula specifications. Sensitivity analyses examine alternative copula families and nested BMI genetic-score constructions to address pleiotropy concerns. The results show that higher BMI increases hypertension risk across ordered blood-pressure severity categories. Probability-scale treatment effects reveal a nonlinear pattern: marginal risk is concentrated in clinically relevant regions of the BMI distribution and shifts from early blood-pressure elevation toward more severe hypertension as body mass increases. The findings illustrate how genetic instruments and copula-based triangular models can be combined to study endogenous continuous treatments with nonlinear health outcomes, while identifying where along the BMI distribution marginal increases in body mass are most consequential for blood-pressure risk.
abstract_zh: 本文利用芬兰青年研究数据，估计了体质指数（BMI）对高血压风险的因果效应。实证框架将BMI的遗传工具变量与三角copula模型相结合，该模型能适应二元结果和连续内生处理变量，允许BMI和高血压的未观测决定因素通过替代的对称和非对称copula设定相关联。敏感性分析考察了不同的copula族和嵌套的BMI遗传评分构建，以应对多效性担忧。结果显示，BMI升高增加了按血压严重程度有序分类的高血压风险。概率尺度上的处理效应揭示了非线性模式：边际风险集中在BMI分布的临床相关区域，并随着体质增加从早期血压升高转向更严重的高血压。研究结果展示了如何结合遗传工具变量和基于copula的三角模型来研究具有非线性健康结果的内生连续处理变量，同时识别出BMI分布中体质边际增加对血压风险影响最为显著的区间。

title: Training AI for When Humans Will Use It
title_zh: 训练人工智能以应对人类使用场景
title_primary: 训练人工智能以应对人类使用场景
title_secondary: Training AI for When Humans Will Use It
authors: Kevin A. Bryan, Joshua S. Gans
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: AI predicts; humans use its predictions to make decisions. These predictions are combined with human verification and analysis, queries to other statistical models, and so on. The economic value of an AI, therefore, depends on how it interacts with the surrounding decision environment. We describe the value of AI as part of this "composite experiment" where AI makes a coarse prediction of the state of the world, show what this means for optimal model training via a geometric argument, explain why optimal training can be discontinuous in economic variables, and study how heterogeneous users or monopoly model trainers affect these results. In particular, maximizing the unconditional accuracy of AI predictions is generally suboptimal.
abstract_zh: 人工智能进行预测，人类则利用这些预测进行决策。这些预测与人类的验证分析、对其他统计模型的查询等环节相结合。因此，人工智能的经济价值取决于其与周围决策环境的互动方式。我们将人工智能的价值描述为这一"复合实验"的组成部分——在该实验中，人工智能对世界状态进行粗略预测，通过几何论证阐明这对最优模型训练的意义，解释为何最优训练在经济变量中可能呈现不连续性，并研究异质性用户或垄断模型训练者如何影响这些结果。特别值得注意的是，最大化人工智能预测的无条件准确性通常并非最优选择。

title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

authors: Zorzi, Nathan, Beraja, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。

title_zh: 核心的实验实现

official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This study experimentally examines a non-cooperative implementation of the core. The protocol adopts a continuous-time frame, which allows a flexible coalition formation process. In the experiment, the core can be a singleton, a set of points that excludes the equal split, or an expanded set of points that includes the equal split. Meanwhile, predictions of the nucleolus and the Shapley value are also discussed for comparison. Results show that although the grand coalition is not always agreed on, the payoffs averaged across all formed coalitions are consistent with the core’s prediction in each scenario.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验考察了核心的非合作实现方式。实验协议采用连续时间框架，允许灵活的联盟形成过程。在实验中，核心可以是单点集、排除均分结果的点集，或包含均分结果的扩展点集。同时，为便于比较，还讨论了核仁解和沙普利值的预测结果。结果表明，尽管大联盟并非总能达成一致，但在每种情境下，所有已形成联盟的平均收益均与核心的预测结果一致。

authors: Erik Frohm, John Hooley, Fatih Ozturk, Lukasz Rawdanowicz, Nivetha Sivakumar
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Global imbalances are back in the policy debate. This column examines 70 current account adjustment episodes across 51 economies from 1980 to 2024 to discover how large imbalances have unwound in the past. Three lessons stand out: adjustments are fairly common but slow; deficit and surplus narrowing work through different channels; and larger imbalances – especially deficits – are significantly more likely to correct.
abstract_zh: 全球失衡问题重新成为政策辩论的焦点。本文考察了1980年至2024年间51个经济体的70次经常账户调整事件，以探究过去大规模失衡是如何化解的。三个关键启示值得关注：调整虽较为常见但进程缓慢；赤字与盈余的收窄通过不同渠道实现；规模较大的失衡——尤其是赤字——更有可能得到纠正。

title: Market Power Is Power
title_zh: 市场力量即权力
title_primary: 市场力量即权力
title_secondary: Market Power Is Power
authors: Gabriele Gratton, Barton Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We argue that in market democracies firms can wield political power through a mechanism that does not rely on lobbying, campaign contributions, or persuasion. When voters cannot commit to future regulation, firms can use irreversible technological investments to reshape ex-post political incentives. We call this mechanism the political hold-up problem. We show that, in equilibrium, a firm's de facto power to avoid regulation coincides with standard measures of market power. This form of power is robust to a wide range of regulatory instruments, including bans, taxes, self-regulation, and delegation to technocrats, and limits the effectiveness of reforms targeting political influence. The political hold-up problem distorts the direction of technological progress and may increase political demand for populism and nationalization. Institutional remedies instead require commitment: supermajoritarian institutions and independent oversight of industry standards.
abstract_zh: 本文论证，在市场民主国家中，企业可通过一种不依赖游说、政治献金或说服的机制行使政治权力。当选民无法对未来监管做出承诺时，企业能够利用不可逆的技术投资重塑事后政治激励。我们将此机制称为"政治套牢问题"。研究表明，在均衡状态下，企业规避监管的事实权力与市场势力的标准度量指标相吻合。这种权力形式对包括禁令、税收、自我监管及技术官僚授权在内的广泛监管工具具有稳健性，并会限制针对政治影响力的改革效力。政治套牢问题会扭曲技术进步方向，并可能加剧对民粹主义与国有化的政治需求。制度性补救措施则需要承诺机制：超级多数制度与行业标准的独立监督。

title: Double Inertia, Taylor Rules, and Monetary Policy Gradualism
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: Double Inertia, Taylor Rules, and Monetary Policy Gradualism
authors: Edmund Crawley, William Goodwin, Margaret M. Jacobson, Fabian Winkler
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In recent decades, an empirically estimated double-inertial rule fits the path of changes in the federal funds rate better than a standard inertial Taylor rule. Inertial Taylor rules aim to capture monetary policy gradualism via slow adjustments in the level of the policy rate. Double-inertial rules build on this specification by also gradually adjusting the pace of change in the policy rate. Because a double-inertial rule explains more than twice the variation of changes in the policy rate than its standard inertial counterpart, we argue that practitioners should consider a double-inertial rule when characterizing U.S. monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，实证估计的双惯性规则比标准惯性泰勒规则更能拟合联邦基金利率的变化路径。惯性泰勒规则旨在通过政策利率水平的缓慢调整来捕捉货币政策的渐进性特征。双惯性规则在此基础上进一步对政策利率变化速度进行渐进调整。由于双惯性规则对政策利率变化方差的解释力是标准惯性规则的两倍以上，我们认为实践者在描述美国货币政策时应考虑采用双惯性规则。

title: Asymmetric thin markets
title_zh: 非对称性薄市场
title_primary: 非对称性薄市场
title_secondary: Asymmetric thin markets
authors: Vincent Fardeau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using a new equilibrium representation, I characterize dynamic, nonstationary risk sharing in a complete-information setting among strategic traders submitting demand schedules and heterogeneous in risk aversion. In equilibrium, more risk-averse (smaller) traders diversify more aggressively due to endogenously lower price impact. This creates term structure effects, where smaller traders dynamically hedge the persistent order flow of larger, slower traders and become the marginal pricers at short horizons. When pre-announced security issuances (e.g., bond reopenings) or predictable trades take place, the model generates the gradual, V-shaped price response observed around these events and delivers new predictions about institutional trading.
abstract_zh: 利用一种新的均衡表示方法，我刻画了在完全信息环境中，风险规避程度异质的策略性交易者提交需求曲线时的动态、非平稳风险分担特征。在均衡状态下，风险规避程度更高（规模更小）的交易者因内生性较低的价格冲击效应而更为积极地分散风险。这产生了期限结构效应，其中较小规模的交易者动态对冲较大且行动较慢交易者的持续性订单流，并在短期视野内成为边际定价者。当预先公告的证券发行（例如债券重新开放）或可预测交易发生时，模型生成了围绕这些事件观察到的渐进式V形价格反应，并为机构交易提供了新的预测。

title: Equity financing and exports: Evidence from IPO approvals in China
title_zh: 股权融资与出口：来自中国IPO审批的证据
title_primary: 股权融资与出口：来自中国IPO审批的证据
title_secondary: Equity financing and exports: Evidence from IPO approvals in China
authors: Robin Kaiji Gong, Yao Amber Li, Stephen Teng Sun, Shang-Jin Wei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study provides the first empirical analysis of how access to equity financing affects firm exports, leveraging China’s stringent approval system for initial public offerings (IPOs). Our empirical strategy compares the export performance of successful IPO applicants with that of “near misses” — applicants rejected at the final review meetings. To sharpen identification, we utilize meeting records to exclude rejections citing concerns about future revenue growth or profitability risks, as these may entail unobserved shocks to export performance. Our cohort-based difference-in-differences analysis reveals that IPO approval leads to a significant annualized increase of more than 6% in firm exports over the subsequent six years. In contrast to previous findings on debt financing, IPO approval primarily affects the extensive margin, enabling firms to expand into more destination-product markets. Mechanism tests suggest that IPOs enhance exports by financing intangible investments and fostering risk-taking activities.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次实证分析了股权融资获取对企业出口的影响，利用中国首次公开募股（IPO）的严格审批制度作为研究背景。我们的实证策略比较了成功通过IPO申请的企业与“擦肩而过”的申请者——即在最终审核会议上被否决的申请者的出口表现。为加强识别，我们利用会议记录排除了因未来收入增长或盈利能力风险担忧而被否决的情况，因为这些担忧可能涉及影响出口表现的未观测冲击。基于队列的双重差分分析显示，IPO批准导致企业出口在随后六年内年均增长超过6%。与以往关于债务融资的研究发现不同，IPO批准主要影响扩展边际，使企业能够拓展至更多的目的地-产品市场。机制检验表明，IPO通过资助无形资产投资和促进风险承担活动来增强企业出口。

title: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
title_zh: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示
title_primary: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示
title_secondary: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
authors: Jian Zhang, Ashok K. Mishra, Gaoli Zhu, Awais Jabbar
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Smallholder farmers in developing countries face the twin challenges of improving productivity and managing agricultural risks. One emerging response is outsourcing production tasks to specialized service providers. Using plot‐level data from rice farms in Jiangsu Province, China, and an endogenous treatment‐regression model, this study examines the effects of outsourcing on yields and production risks. Results show that outsourcing increases rice yields by nearly 3%, reduces yield volatility, and lowers the probability of crop failure. These benefits arise from greater access to mechanized services, the substitution of machinery for labor, and more efficient use of inputs. However, outcomes vary by type: machinery‐intensive outsourcing reduces risk, whereas labor‐intensive outsourcing can exacerbate it in weak service markets. Gains are greatest on larger and more fertile plots, underscoring the importance of policies that support mechanization and competitive service markets.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的农户面临提升生产力和管理农业风险的双重挑战。一种新兴应对策略是将生产任务外包给专业化服务提供商。本研究利用中国江苏省水稻种植的地块层面数据，采用内生处理回归模型，考察了外包对产量和生产风险的影响。结果表明，外包使水稻产量提升近3%，降低了产量波动性，并减少了作物歉收的概率。这些效益源于机械化服务的更易获取、机械对劳动力的替代以及投入要素的更高效利用。然而，不同外包类型的效果存在差异：机械密集型外包降低了风险，而劳动密集型外包在薄弱服务市场中可能加剧风险。在面积更大、土壤更肥沃的地块上，外包效益最为显著，这凸显了支持机械化和竞争性服务市场的政策重要性。

title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
title_zh: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据
title_primary: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据
title_secondary: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
authors: Kim Lan Nguyen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
abstract_zh: 土地细碎化被广泛认为是制约小农农业的瓶颈，它提高了生产成本、限制了机械化进程并降低了生产效率。许多国家推行了土地整合计划以应对这一问题，但其经济效果不仅取决于地块重组，还依赖于制度实施和土地市场运行。本文利用越南两个实施土地整合省份的六轮农户面板数据（2008-2018年），考察了该国政府主导的土地整合计划的影响。采用双向固定效应和考虑异质性采纳时点的交错双重差分法进行效应估计。结果显示：土地整合计划显著降低了土地细碎化程度——每户地块数量减少约3块，平均地块面积增加约66%，地块与宅基地距离缩短约23%。与此同时，重新颁发土地使用权证过程中的行政延迟导致有证土地和可抵押土地比例暂时下降。虽然农户整体信贷获取未受负面影响，但土地租赁市场受到显著干扰，租入和租出行为均出现减少。这种土地交易的缩减可能阻碍土地有效再配置和经营规模调整，从而延缓因土地结构改善带来的投资和生产率提升。总体而言，研究结果凸显了制度实施与配套市场功能对越南及其他小农经济体实现土地整合效益的关键作用。

title: What motivates Irish farmers to participate in new afforestation schemes: Financial or environmental drivers?
title_zh: 什么激励爱尔兰农民参与新造林计划：经济驱动还是环境驱动？
title_primary: 什么激励爱尔兰农民参与新造林计划：经济驱动还是环境驱动？
title_secondary: What motivates Irish farmers to participate in new afforestation schemes: Financial or environmental drivers?
authors: Zohreh Rafiee, James Breen, Kevin Kilcline, Mohammad Mohammadrezaei
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Afforestation is the most significant land-based strategy for enhancing carbon sequestration and mitigating climate change globally. However, in many countries, including Ireland, planting targets remain unmet despite the availability of financial incentives. The latest Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) reform introduced Small-Scale Afforestation Measures (SSAMs) to encourage tree planting on Irish farms, but barriers and motivations for adoption remain poorly understood. Accordingly, this study examines both external factors (e.g. financial incentives) and intrinsic motives (e.g., beliefs, values, attitudes, and social norms) influencing the adoption of SSAMs, which is crucial for designing more effective and targeted afforestation policies. Using data from a nationally representative survey of 563 Irish farms, the extended Theory of Planned Behaviour was applied to distinguish the influence of different beliefs, subjective norm, and barriers. A Generalised Linear Model with Ordinal Regression was used to analyse farmers’ adoption intentions. Results showed over half of farmers were either ‘neutral’ or ‘unwilling’ to adopt SSAMs, while 38.9%, 32.0%, and 45.1% were ‘willing’ to adopt tree planting of ‘Any-kind’, under CAP Pillar I ‘Eco-scheme’, and CAP Pillar II ‘Agri-Environment-Climate Measures (AECMs)’, respectively. Most background factors were not significant to adoption, and while socio-psychological factors emerged as particularly significant. Economic beliefs shaped farmers’ attitudes toward AECM adoption, while environmental beliefs were key drivers for Eco-Scheme participation. Findings suggest that adoption can be improved by combining financial incentives with participatory training to engage influential peer groups. Addressing both economic concerns and environmental values is essential for enhancing the effectiveness of afforestation policies and increasing uptake.
abstract_zh: 植树造林是全球范围内增强碳汇和减缓气候变化的最重要的陆地策略。然而，在许多国家，包括爱尔兰，尽管有财政激励措施，植树目标仍未实现。最新的共同农业政策（CAP）改革引入了小规模造林措施（SSAMs），以鼓励爱尔兰农场植树，但采纳的障碍和动机仍鲜为人知。因此，本研究考察了影响SSAMs采纳的外部因素（如财政激励）和内在动机（如信念、价值观、态度和社会规范），这对于设计更有效和有针对性的造林政策至关重要。利用对563个爱尔兰农场的全国代表性调查数据，应用扩展的计划行为理论来区分不同信念、主观规范和障碍的影响。采用带有序数回归的广义线性模型分析农民的采纳意愿。结果显示，超过一半的农民对采纳SSAMs持“中立”或“不愿意”态度，而分别有38.9%、32.0%和45.1%的农民“愿意”采纳“任意类型”的植树、CAP第一支柱下的“生态计划”和CAP第二支柱下的“农业环境气候措施（AECMs）”。大多数背景因素对采纳不显著，而社会心理因素尤为显著。经济信念塑造了农民对AECM采纳的态度，而环境信念是参与生态计划的关键驱动力。研究结果表明，将财政激励与参与式培训相结合，以吸引有影响力的同行群体，可以改善采纳情况。解决经济关切和环境价值观对于提高造林政策的有效性和增加采纳率至关重要。

title: Monotone optimal trajectories in continuous-time infinite horizon optimal control problems
title_zh: 连续时间无限时域最优控制问题中的单调最优轨迹
title_primary: 连续时间无限时域最优控制问题中的单调最优轨迹
title_secondary: Monotone optimal trajectories in continuous-time infinite horizon optimal control problems
authors: Niko Jaakkola, Florian Wagener
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We give weak conditions for a continuous time optimal control problem with one-dimensional state space to have monotone optimal trajectories. These conditions include a concavity condition on the Lagrange function. If that condition is changed to strict concavity, then all optimal trajectories are monotone.
abstract_zh: 我们给出了在一维状态空间中，连续时间最优控制问题具有单调最优轨迹的弱条件。这些条件包括对拉格朗日函数的凹性要求。若将该条件加强为严格凹性，则所有最优轨迹均为单调的。

title: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
title_zh: 基于核化的非参数二元选择模型方法
title_primary: 基于核化的非参数二元选择模型方法
title_secondary: A kernelization-based approach to nonparametric binary choice models
authors: Guo Yan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a new estimator for nonparametric binary choice models that does not impose a parametric structure on either the systematic function of covariates or the distribution of the error term. A key advantage of our approach is its computational scalability in the number of covariates. For instance, even when assuming a normal error distribution as in probit models, commonly used sieves for approximating an unknown function of covariates can lead to a large-dimensional optimization problem when the number of covariates is moderate. Our approach, motivated by kernel methods in machine learning, views certain reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces as special sieve spaces, coupled with spectral cut-off regularization for dimension reduction. We establish the consistency of the proposed estimator and asymptotic normality of the plug-in estimator for weighted average partial derivatives. Simulation studies show that, compared to parametric estimation methods, the proposed method effectively improves finite sample performance in cases of misspecification, and has a rather mild efficiency loss if the model is correctly specified. Using administrative data on the grant decisions of US asylum applications to immigration courts, along with nine case-day variables on weather and pollution, we re-examine the effect of outdoor temperature on court judges' ``mood'', and thus, their grant decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的非参数二元选择模型估计方法，该方法无需对协变量的系统函数或误差项的分布施加参数结构。我们方法的一个关键优势在于其计算可扩展性，能够处理协变量数量较多的情况。例如，即使在如probit模型中假设正态误差分布时，常用的筛法（sieves）在协变量数量适中时，也可能导致高维优化问题。我们的方法受机器学习中的核方法启发，将特定的再生核希尔伯特空间视为特殊筛空间，并结合谱截断正则化进行降维。我们证明了所提估计量的一致性，以及加权平均偏导数插件估计量的渐近正态性。模拟研究表明，与参数估计方法相比，所提方法在模型误设情况下能有效改善有限样本性能，而在模型正确设定时，其效率损失相对较小。利用美国移民法院庇护申请裁决的行政数据，以及九个关于天气和污染的案例日变量，我们重新审视了室外温度对法官“情绪”及其裁决决定的影响。

title: Economic dynamics of the Early Roman Empire: Insights from lead pollution, coinage, weather, and war
title_zh: 早期罗马帝国的经济动态：来自铅污染、铸币、天气与战争的洞见
title_primary: 早期罗马帝国的经济动态：来自铅污染、铸币、天气与战争的洞见
title_secondary: Economic dynamics of the Early Roman Empire: Insights from lead pollution, coinage, weather, and war
authors: Luigi Oddo, Silvio Traverso, Koenraad Verboven
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the relationship between anthropogenic lead pollution recorded in Greenland ice cores and economic dynamics during the Pax Romana (27 BC–180 AD), a period of relative political, institutional and technological stability in the Early Roman Empire. Our findings reveal that approximately one-fourth of the annual variability in lead pollution during this period can be explained by summer temperatures, silver coin output, and warfare – three factors plausibly linked to fluctuations of the Empire’s economy. Using annual time-series analysis, we integrate high-resolution paleoclimatic, paleoenvironmental, and cliometric data to investigate short-run economic dynamics in an ancient society. Specifically, our results suggest that warmer summers, which likely boosted agricultural yields, were positively associated with increased economic activity. In contrast, higher production of silver coins and periods of warfare were associated with lower levels of lead emissions, suggesting that these factors were associated with periods of weaker aggregate economic activity. Our analysis also provides formal statistical support for the hypothesis that historical lead pollution levels contain valuable information about economic activity in ancient Europe, thereby corroborating a highly debated claim in the literature.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了格陵兰冰芯中记录的人为铅污染与罗马和平时期（公元前27年至公元180年）经济动态之间的关系，这一时期是早期罗马帝国政治、制度和技术相对稳定的阶段。研究发现，该时期铅污染年际变异的约四分之一可由夏季温度、银币产量及战争活动解释，这三者与帝国经济的波动存在合理关联。通过年度时间序列分析，我们整合了高分辨率古气候、古环境及计量历史数据，以探究古代社会的短期经济动态。具体而言，研究结果表明，较为温暖的夏季可能促进农业收成，并与经济活动的增加呈正相关。相反，银币产量的增加及战争时期则与铅排放水平下降相关，暗示这些因素与总体经济活动减弱时期相关联。我们的分析还为历史铅污染水平蕴含古代欧洲经济活动有价值信息这一假说提供了正式的统计支持，从而印证了文献中一个备受争议的观点。

title: Demand Estimation with Text and Image Data
title_zh: 基于文本与图像数据的需求估计
title_primary: 基于文本与图像数据的需求估计
title_secondary: Demand Estimation with Text and Image Data
authors: Giovanni Compiani, Ilya Morozov, Stephan Seiler
official: 官方在线 2026-03-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a demand estimation approach that leverages unstructured data to infer substitution patterns. Using pre-trained deep learning models, we extract embeddings from product images and textual descriptions and incorporate them into a mixed logit demand model. This approach enables demand estimation even when researchers lack data on product attributes or when consumers value hard-to-quantify attributes such as visual design. Using a choice experiment, we show this approach substantially outperforms standard attribute-based models at counterfactual predictions of second choices. We also apply it to 40 product categories offered on Amazon.com and consistently find that unstructured data are informative about substitution patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种需求估计方法，利用非结构化数据来推断替代模式。通过使用预训练的深度学习模型，我们从产品图像和文本描述中提取嵌入，并将其纳入混合逻辑需求模型。这种方法使得即使研究者缺乏产品属性数据，或消费者重视难以量化的属性（如视觉设计）时，也能进行需求估计。通过选择实验，我们证明该方法在反事实预测第二选择方面显著优于基于属性的标准模型。我们还将此方法应用于Amazon.com上提供的40个产品类别，并一致发现非结构化数据对替代模式具有信息价值。

title: Fragmentation or inequality: Ethnic divisions and conflict in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 碎片化还是不平等：撒哈拉以南非洲的族群分裂与冲突
title_primary: 碎片化还是不平等：撒哈拉以南非洲的族群分裂与冲突
title_secondary: Fragmentation or inequality: Ethnic divisions and conflict in Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Boris Gershman, Ameesh Upadhyay
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between local ethnic divisions and conflict in Sub-Saharan Africa. Using census subsamples and large-scale household surveys, we construct a new subnational dataset on ethnic inequality capturing group-level differences in education, asset ownership, and access to basic amenities for several hundred regions in thirty-five countries. To distinguish between deep-rooted and more recent ethnic divisions, we incorporate groups from our sample into Ethnologue’s linguistic tree model and generate alternative measures of both ethnic fractionalization and inequality based on ancestral languages. Our analysis, leveraging within-country variation and accounting for numerous regional characteristics, reveals a robust positive relationship between ethnic fractionalization and conflict, especially when using deeper linguistic cleavages to define distinct groups. In contrast, ethnic inequality shows no systematic association with conflict frequency or severity. These findings suggest the primacy of ethnolinguistic differences per se, rather than socioeconomic disparities between groups, as a driver of local conflict.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了撒哈拉以南非洲地区地方民族分裂与冲突之间的关系。利用人口普查子样本和大规模家庭调查数据，我们构建了一个新的次国家级数据集，用以衡量民族不平等，该数据集涵盖了三十五个国家数百个地区在群体层面上的教育、资产所有权及基本生活设施获取差异。为区分根深蒂固与较新近的民族分裂，我们将样本中的群体纳入Ethnologue语言树模型，并基于祖先语言生成了民族分裂化与不平等的替代度量指标。我们的分析利用国内差异并控制众多区域特征，揭示了民族分裂化与冲突之间存在稳健的正相关关系，尤其是在使用更深层的语言分裂来界定不同群体时。相比之下，民族不平等与冲突频率或严重程度之间并无系统性关联。这些发现表明，民族语言差异本身，而非群体间的社会经济差距，是地方冲突的主要驱动因素。

title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据
title_primary: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据
title_secondary: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
authors: Melis Kartal, Wieland Müller
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.
abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们提出一种新方法，通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体，其中合作偏好具有异质性，且战略风险源于对对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法能够系统性地解释包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。

title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型
title_primary: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型
title_secondary: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
authors: Joshua C. C. Chan, Christian Matthes, Xuewen Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型在结构分析中日益被用作统一框架，以同时研究多种结构性冲击的影响。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量脉冲响应结构约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号和排序约束的VAR模型来识别8种结构性冲击，并以此为例进行说明。

title: Women in Politics: The Effect on Board Diversity
title_zh: 女性参政：对董事会多元化的影响
title_primary: 女性参政：对董事会多元化的影响
title_secondary: Women in Politics: The Effect on Board Diversity
authors: Kedia, Simi, Pareek, Ankur
source: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
official: 官方在线 2025-12-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We use a sharp regression discontinuity design (RDD) to show that victories by women candidates in close House, Senate, and gubernatorial elections lead to an increase in female directors in firms located in the candidates’ districts. The causal effect is higher when the media coverage of the woman candidate is higher, when voter turnout is high, and when firms have more local directors and local institutional investors. The heterogeneous regression discontinuity (RD) effects suggest that electoral wins may influence local gender norms and firms’ board diversity through multiple channels, including conveying majority views on gender-related social norms, increasing exposure to exemplar women, and facilitating learning about women’s different but effective leadership styles. The evidence suggests a potential spillover effect from women’s political leadership to the corporate world.
abstract_zh: 我们采用精确断点回归设计（RDD）证明，在竞争激烈的众议院、参议院及州长选举中，女性候选人的胜利会导致其所在选区企业女性董事数量的增加。当媒体对女性候选人的报道增多、选民投票率高，以及企业拥有更多本地董事和本地机构投资者时，这一因果效应更为显著。异质性断点回归（RD）效应表明，选举胜利可能通过多种渠道影响当地性别规范及企业董事会多样性，包括传达关于性别相关社会规范的大多数观点、增加对榜样女性的接触，以及促进对女性不同但有效领导风格的学习。证据表明，女性政治领导力可能向企业界产生溢出效应。

title: The spatial effect of airport proximity on house prices: a quantile regression analysis for the New Zealand market
title_zh: 机场邻近性对房价的空间效应：新西兰市场的分位数回归分析
title_primary: 机场邻近性对房价的空间效应：新西兰市场的分位数回归分析
title_secondary: The spatial effect of airport proximity on house prices: a quantile regression analysis for the New Zealand market
authors: Graham Squires Thanh Ngo Michael James McCord Daniel Lo Xueqi Wang a Property Department, Lincoln University, Christchurch, New Zealandb School of Aviation, Massey University, Palmerston North 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study contributes to understanding the link between the housing market and airport location proximity, whilst examining the entirety of the house price distribution. The research investigates this association across four key urban areas within New Zealand proximal to an international airport – Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, and Queenstown. Applying hedonic and quantile regression, the analysis reveals that proximity to airports on house prices has a heterogeneous pricing effect. Results show that distance comprises a positive pricing effect within Auckland and Christchurch, whereas in Wellington and Queenstown the pricing effect is negative. The quantile regression findings further revealed differences between lower and higher priced properties value, given distance and proximity to airports within each city region. The Christchurch region reveals contrasting findings, showing there to be a higher positive pricing effect for higher-priced housing, which gradually decreases when moving down the quantiles. It is argued that this higher positive pricing for higher priced properties is due to particularities in the housing market close to Christchurch Airport.
abstract_zh: 本研究有助于理解住房市场与机场区位邻近性之间的关系，同时考察了房价分布的完整区间。研究调查了新西兰四个靠近国际机场的主要城市区域——奥克兰、惠灵顿、基督城和皇后镇——中这一关联性。通过应用特征价格模型和分位数回归，分析揭示了机场邻近性对房价存在异质性的定价效应。结果显示，在奥克兰和基督城，距离对房价具有正向定价效应，而在惠灵顿和皇后镇，定价效应则为负向。分位数回归结果进一步揭示了各城市区域内，低价值与高价值房产在距离和机场邻近性方面的差异。基督城地区呈现出对比性发现：高价位住房的正向定价效应更强，且随着分位数下移而逐渐减弱。本文认为，高价位房产更强的正向定价效应源于基督城机场附近住房市场的特殊性。
